Jesus... my best friend got the promotion I trained her for. I clapped first. 👏

Bible verse for jealousy at work.

Her best friend at work got the promotion she trained her for, and she clapped first while envy ate at her.

Jesus: “No. You're being honest. Envy grows in the dark. Bring it to Me and it loosens its grip.”

“A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.”
Proverbs 14:30 (BSB)

Her win took nothing from your worth.

💬 Have you ever clapped while it stung?

youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Bible verse for jealousy at work.

She: Jesus... my best friend got the promotion I trained her for. I clapped first. 👏
She: I taught her the reports. Now she's my lead. I smiled through the whole cake.
Jesus: Your hands clapped. Your heart kept score.
She: So I'm a terrible friend for feeling this?
Jesus: No. You're being honest. Envy grows in the dark. Bring it to Me and it loosens its grip.
Jesus: Her win took nothing from your worth.

“A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.”
Proverbs 14:30 (BSB)

💬 Have you ever clapped while it stung?
